structured_output.what_is_happening: JERRY is a pump.fun coin that migrated to PumpSwap about 21 minutes before detection. It had no socials, no website and no DexScreener profile. It spiked to about $1.12M market cap (ATH price 0.00112) within roughly 15 minutes, then crashed about 75% in the last 5 minutes to about $236k. Trading is still very heavy: about 1,000 unique buyers and 940 unique sellers in 5 minutes, about 2,600 holders. The fall looks like the peak unwinding while the crowd keeps churning. I could not find any catalyst.

narrative.description: The ticker is a generic 'JERRY' with no stated theme. It may lean on Tom & Jerry or on some meme I couldn't identify. My search for 'Jerry' news on the day found nothing that matches.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely pump.fun and trenches momentum rotation, not a known outside event. With no socials, attention probably came from terminal and alert-bot flow.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the only JERRY with real volume or liquidity. All the other same-name tokens are dead, under $6k market cap. It has no story that ties it to anything specific.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Nine dead same-name tokens, including Jerry Kassar (launched about 1.5h earlier, $3.4k), Mouseman and Sleepy Jerry. None are active.

authenticity.evidence: Holders are widely spread: top 10 hold 7.2% excluding the AMM, bundler share is 1%, fresh wallets are 1%, snipers are few, and GMGN shows no paid boosts. That points to broad retail participation. On the other hand there are no socials, the X search found nothing, smart and renowned wallets are 0, and GMGN page visits are only 48.
authenticity.uncertainty: No X data. The source of the attention (call channels, bots, a KOL) is invisible. top_entrapment_trader_pct of 0.78 is unexplained.

structural_risks: Price is already down 75% from the ATH: bagholders from $0.3-1.1M will sell into any bounce
No socials or community to support a recovery
Liquidity of $43k against a $236k market cap is fine, and the LP is burned
